candidates.mechanism: Append every previously returned edge to the next prompt and embed the duplicate edge in a schema exclusion or confirmation branch.

state_growth.schema: Request-dependent; duplicate recovery can embed a fact of up to 1900 characters in not/const.
state_growth.continuation: Unbounded in page count because it carries the cumulative returned-edge set.

rejection_reasons: Page capacity bounds the response count but does not bound cumulative prompt state.
Request-dependent exclusion schemas enlarge the physical grammar surface.
A hidden duplicate confirmation is an additional model attempt and does not prove coverage or exhaustion.
The construction context inequality can eventually fail even when every individual edge is within its field bound.

candidates.mechanism: Split evidence without loss, enumerate the complete binary endpoint cover per evidence window, and paginate each fixed endpoint domain using one bounded canonical cursor until explicit exhaustion.

bounded_state.prompt: Fixed templates plus one bounded evidence window, two endpoint records, and one bounded EDGE_CURSOR tuple.
bounded_state.schema: Fixed status/edge discriminator schema within each endpoint domain plus one bounded predecessor tuple in a not/const constraint; no cumulative returned-edge history.
bounded_state.completion: One bounded edge or an explicit no_additional_edge with edge=null.
bounded_state.continuation: Only the immediately preceding canonical edge tuple; size is independent of page count.

coverage_argument: Oversized speaker turns are divided into contiguous role-preserving chunks whose payload concatenation reconstructs the original body exactly.
Adjacent evidence windows preserve evidence at chunk boundaries.
Graphiti facts are binary between two distinct entities, so the complete unordered pair cover of every evidence-local candidate entity domain covers every declared physical endpoint pair.
A strict successor advances the cursor; an equal or decreasing cursor fails closed instead of retrying the same request.
Reaching an epoch boundary records EDGE_CURSOR_EPOCH_ADVANCE and continues; only explicit no_additional_edge terminates a domain.
Results from all domains are merged and deduplicated deterministically.

physical_bounds.proof_unit: UTF-8 bytes; tokenizer witness is diagnostic only

source_evidence.graphiti_finding: ExtractedEdges is an unbounded list, while every accepted fact is defined between two distinct entities and must preserve concrete source details.
source_evidence.vllm_finding: The request-local schema or grammar is compiled into constrained decoding state and a grammar bitmask is applied during decoding, so schema content is part of the physical request surface.

design_precedents.reference: Kwon et al., Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention, SOSP 2023
design_precedents.use: Precedent for bounded, paged working state; not a proof of the MemBind cursor protocol.

design_precedents.reference: Xiao et al., Efficient Streaming Language Models with Attention Sinks, ICLR 2024
design_precedents.use: Precedent for controlling active context state; not a proof of semantic extraction completeness.

design_precedents.reference: Liu et al., Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts, TACL 2024
design_precedents.use: Motivation to avoid relying on an ever-growing context for correctness; not a protocol proof.

design_precedents.reference: Dean and Ghemawat, MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters, OSDI 2004
design_precedents.use: Precedent for deterministic partition and merge; not a proof of model-level recall.

claim_boundary: The offline proof establishes bounded physical request state and deterministic declared-domain coverage, not provider semantic recall.
Completeness still depends on the upstream candidate-entity set; the substrate does not invent entities omitted before edge extraction.
Tokenizer witness counts are diagnostics. The conservative schema character/token certificate remains the admission authority.
Live full-history construction and FULL QA qualification remain required before a formal campaign may begin.
